candidates.name: full-p-synthesis-w8a8-ptq
candidates.reason: Quantizing the decoder and reconstruction graph corrupts recurrent feature state and visible output.

candidates.name: reconstruction-only-w8a8-ptq
candidates.calibration: Entropy calibration from 12 real 360p QP-32 frame pairs across BasketballDrive, HoneyBee, and Jockey.
candidates.reason: Keeping the recurrent feature output FP16 prevents temporal-state poisoning, but W8A8 PTQ still destroys reconstruction quality.

implementation_notes: NVIDIA ModelOpt 0.45 explicit Q/DQ quantization was used.
TensorRT 10.3 on Jetson required Q/DQ scale initializers to be converted from FP16 to FP32.
TensorRT selected real INT8 tactics; the observed speedup establishes an Orin INT8 opportunity.
The disposable benchmark bundle was stamped as FP16 only because the current runtime rejects any precision string other than fp16; it is not a production artifact.
The reconstruction engine was bounded to the padded 640x384 workload after larger tactic searches exceeded fragmented unified-memory headroom.
conclusion: Do not ship either PTQ engine. Continue with quantization-aware training or sensitivity-guided mixed precision with explicit quality gates.
